nutritionTip.title: Nutrition Strategy for Muscle Building & Hypertrophy
nutritionTip.coreAdvice: Align your daily nutrition with your routine. For Muscle Building & Hypertrophy, focus on whole foods, steady protein intake, and consistent hydration. Dietary preference: High Protein Focus.
nutritionTip.proteinRecommendation: Aim for 1.4 to 1.8 grams of protein per kilogram of body weight spread across 3-4 meals to preserve and recover muscle fibers.
nutritionTip.hydrationTip: Drink 2.5 to 3 Liters of water daily. Keep a water bottle close during workouts and replenish with an extra 500ml on training days.
nutritionTip.mealTiming: Consume a light, carbohydrate-rich snack 45-60 minutes before training, and enjoy a balanced protein + complex carb meal within 90 minutes post-workout.
nutritionTip.recoveryNote: Target 7 to 8 hours of quality sleep nightly to optimize hormonal recovery and tissue repair.

originalPlan.title: 3-Day Home Toning & Sculpting Program
originalPlan.weeklySplit: Full Body Alternating Split (e.g., Monday, Wednesday, Friday)
originalPlan.overview: A beginner-friendly, 3-day full-body resistance training plan designed for Sam to build lean muscle tone, enhance core stability, and sculpt the entire body using dumbbells and resistance bands at home.

days.dayName: Full Body Sculpt: Lower Body & Push Focus
days.focus: Quadriceps, Glutes, Chest, Shoulders, and Core
days.warmup: 5 minutes of light cardio (marching in place, arm circles, leg swings, and bodyweight squats)
days.cooldown: 5 minutes of static stretching focusing on quads, chest, and hip flexors

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Hold one dumbbell vertically at chest level; maintain an upright torso.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
exercises.notes: Lie flat on the floor with knees bent; press dumbbells up smoothly.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Glute Bridges
exercises.notes: Place mini-band just above knees; squeeze glutes at the top.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Overhead Shoulder Press
exercises.notes: Perform seated or standing; keep core braced without arching the lower back.

exercises.name: Plank with Shoulder Taps
exercises.notes: Keep hips as still as possible while tapping opposite shoulders.

days.dayName: Full Body Sculpt: Posterior Chain & Pull Focus
days.focus: Hamstrings, Glutes, Upper Back, Biceps, and Abs
days.warmup: 5 minutes of dynamic mobility (cat-cow stretches, bird-dogs, inchworms, and torso twists)
days.cooldown: 5 minutes of static stretching focusing on hamstrings, latissimus dorsi, and glutes

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Hinge at hips with soft knees; keep spine neutral and dumbbells close to shins.

exercises.name: Bent-Over Dumbbell Rows
exercises.notes: Pull elbows toward hips and squeeze shoulder blades together.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Lateral Band Walks
exercises.notes: Place band around ankles or above knees; stay in a quarter-squat stance.

exercises.name: Standing Dumbbell Bicep Curls
exercises.notes: Control the descent; avoid swinging elbows forward.

exercises.name: Deadbugs
exercises.notes: Keep lower back pressed firmly into the floor throughout.

days.focus: Total Body Toning, Core Stability, and Muscular Endurance
days.warmup: 5 minutes of dynamic warm-up (jumping jacks, high knees, hip openers, and bodyweight lunges)
days.cooldown: 5 minutes of full body stretching and deep breathing exercises

exercises.name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunges
exercises.notes: Step backward and lower hips until front thigh is parallel to floor.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Lat Pulldowns
exercises.notes: Anchor band overhead; pull down towards collarbones squeezing shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raises
exercises.notes: Use lighter weights; lead with elbows and raise to shoulder height.

exercises.name: Overhead Dumbbell Tricep Extension
exercises.notes: Keep elbows tucked close to head; lower weight behind head smoothly.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Pallof Press
exercises.notes: Press band straight out in front of chest while resisting torso rotation.

tipsForSuccess: Prioritize vegetarian protein sources such as tofu, tempeh, Greek yogurt, lentils, and protein shakes to hit around 1.4-1.6g of protein per kg of body weight for optimal toning.
Focus on progressive overload by gradually increasing dumbbell weight or band tension as movements become easier over time.
Schedule at least one rest or light recovery day (walking, gentle yoga) between each workout day to allow muscles to repair and tone.
